item.title: Miscreants attack guest house staff in Bhubaneswar, 3 held
item.description: Bhubaneswar: Panic gripped the Khandagiri area of Bhubaneswar late last night after a group of youths allegedly stormed into a guest house, assaulted the staff and looted cash. The incident took place at a guest house in the Gandamunda locality under Khandagiri police limits. According to initial information, the accused entered the premises and attacked employees on duty. item.title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25 per cent, sticks to neutral monetary policy
item.description: Mumbai: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra announced on Friday that the Monetary Policy Committee has unanimously decided to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at the current level of 5.25 per cent and stick to the neutral monetary policy stance. The RBI Governor said that the decision to maintain the status quo in the policy rate had been taken after careful consideration of the macroeconomic conditions and the outlook for the economy ahead. item.title: SEBI proposes to extend standing SWP, STP instructions to demat-held mutual funds
item.description: Mumbai: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has proposed to allow investors to set up standing instructions for systematic withdrawal plans (SWP) and systematic transfer plans (STP) for mutual fund units held in demat accounts, a facility currently available only for units held in the statement‑of‑account mode. item.title: Indian Army renames 246 roads and buildings, shedding colonial-era legacy
item.description: New Delhi: The campaign to break free from the colonial mindset continues, with the Indian Army renaming 246 roads and buildings that carried British-era names. Army Reclaims Heritage: British-Era Names Replaced Across Cantonments The move aligns with Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s call to shed symbols of colonial rule and reclaim India’s historical and cultural identity. item.title: Odisha: Vikram Dev University student foils abduction bid, escapes with injuries
item.description: Jeypore: In a disturbing incident, miscreants attempted to kidnap a university student in Jeypore in Odisha's Koraput district on Thursday afternoon. The victims, identified as Moukit Acharya, a third-year Commerce student of Vikram Deb University in Jeypore, managed to break free after a scuffle. The accused, however, fled the scene. item.description: Bhubaneswar: The Odisha government has asked all concerned departments to identify vacant and unutilised government buildings in urban areas so that they can be converted into affordable rental housing units under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban 2.0. item.title: Malayalam actor Maniyanpillai Raju arrested, granted bail in Thiruvananthapuram hit-and-run case
item.description: Thiruvananthapuram: Popular Malayalam actor Maniyanpillai Raju, who appeared before the Museum Police here on Friday, has been arrested in connection with a hit-and-run case in which two men riding a motorcycle sustained serious injuries. Police recorded his arrest and took him for a mandatory medical examination as part of the legal procedure. Later, he was given bail from the Museum Police station. item.title: Gold slips, silver tumbles over 3% as strong dollar, tech selloff weigh on metals
item.description: Mumbai: Gold prices fell moderately, while silver lost over 3 per cent on Friday due to a stronger dollar and a rout in global technology stocks. MCX Gold falls nearly 1%, silver sees sharp intraday correction MCX gold February futures fell 0.97 per cent to Rs 1,50,590 per 10 grams around 10.40 am on an intraday basis.
